items.title: Live: Police say shooting 'justified' after Dezi Freeman's death ends manhunt
items.description: The 56-year-old had been a fugitive since a shooting at his property that killed two police officers.

items.title: Dezi Freeman killed in three-hour standoff in Victoria's north-east
items.description: Freeman had been wanted since last August over the fatal shooting of two police officers at Porepunkah.

items.title: The volatile, 'unemployable' man who became a notorious police killer
items.description: Before Dezi Freeman's death brought an end to a long manhunt, his friends say he was a troubled and divisive figure who was drawn to the anti-authority "sovereign citizen" movement.

items.title: Albanese was on the brink of a disastrous misstep — but then came the pivot
items.description: The pandemic demonstrated that when global events become local, Australians are quick to turn on even a mighty trading partner. There is a real capacity here for the war to sour our attitude to the US alliance.

items.title: Israel admits editing photo, war to intensify in Lebanon, and what else you should know
items.description: The Israel Defense Forces has been forced to admit it edited a photo of Ali Shoeib to show him in a military uniform.

items.title: Live: National cabinet meets on fuel crisis as government seeks to avoid 'COVID-style' restrictions
items.description: The federal government says it wants to avoid COVID-style restrictions as national cabinet convenes to discuss a coordinated response to the fuel crisis. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Iran threatens to retaliate if Pentagon orders ground operation
items.description: US media is reporting that the Pentagon is considering a weeks-long ground campaign in Iran. Follow our live coverage.

items.title: Rising fuel costs force Australians to rethink Easter holidays
items.description: Rising fuel prices driven by the Middle East conflict are hitting the domestic tourism sector, with cancellations surging ahead of the Easter long weekend.

items.title: ‘Surge in interest’ in electric truck conversions amid fuel crisis
items.description: A Central Coast business is converting diesel trucks to electric, amid rising fuel prices across Australia, with the first end-to-end electric delivery from Sydney to Canberra highlighting the potential of battery-powered freight.

items.title: Live: ASX down 1.5pc to follow Wall Street, oil up sharply as Houthis enter war
items.description: The ASX 200 is down 1.5 per cent in Monday trade, losing an estimated $40 billion, as investors dump banks and tech stock in the wake of Wall Street losses on Friday night. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: As universities cut courses, spending on consultants and contractors nears $2b
items.description: Consultancies have been accused of infiltrating universities and wasting scarce public funds on questionable advice about cutting courses and jobs.

items.title: Teen says single parent bias is leaving Australian families homeless
items.description: Hunter was plunged into homelessness when his family lost their rental. It is an increasingly similar story to other single parents finding themselves "lifelong renters".

items.title: Exmouth beaches a 'graveyard' after ex-Tropical Cyclone Narelle
items.description: In the popular tourist destination, it appears the category four cyclone has chewed up and spat out whole sections of the Ningaloo Reef onto dry land.

items.title: Six MV Raider crew members charged with smuggling cocaine
items.description: Australian police have charged six crew members of the high profile MV Raider vessel with drug smuggling, saying they attempted to bring 1 tonne of cocaine into Australia after being intercepted by French Polynesian authorities earlier this year.

items.title: King penguin's arrival in WA prompts 'high-level' biosecurity response
items.description: The king penguin, known for being the second-largest penguin species and living on ice-free parts of the sub-Antarctic, was rescued near Esperance on WA's south coast.

items.title: The best and worst things about being on reality TV, according to Guy Sebastian
items.description: Singing his way into the Australian public's hearts way back in 2003, Guy Sebastian has since had a fascinating and varied career. We catch up with the star to find out about the little things that keep him going — from his two sons to his favourite TV show.

items.title: Photos explore psychological drama of Australian rural life
items.description: Western Australian documentary photographer Brad Rimmer's beautiful, melancholy images of Wheatbelt life sprawl through Fremantle gallery.

items.title: Decisions made more than a decade ago are coming home to roost
items.description: The early 2010s were the years of peak globalisation, when it seemed all trade barriers were on a one-way trip to elimination. That was before Donald Trump arrived and ruptured the global order.

items.title: One Nation claims seat of MacKillop, its third in South Australia's lower house
items.description: A former immigration detention system worker on Christmas Island has won the seat of MacKillop.

items.title: 'I feel betrayed': New scam figures show Australians lost more than $2 billion
items.description: Australians lost more than $2 billion to scammers in 2025, the latest data from the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has revealed.

items.title: How to discuss additional work-from-home days with your employer
items.description: With rising fuel prices adding additional financial stress to household living costs, what are your rights when it comes to working from home — and what are the best ways to approach your employer about flexible work arrangements?

items.title: South Australia wins back-to-back Shield titles with stunning win over Victoria
items.description: South Australia has won back-to-back Sheffield Shield titles with a brilliant comeback victory over Victoria in the final at Melbourne's Junction Oval.

items.title: The 'cricketer's' injury that kept this cyclist out for a year and how she fought back
items.description: Kristina Clonan suffered an injury more common to fast bowlers than cyclists that kept her out of action for an entire year. In her time off, she established a scholarship to elevate young riders and learned from Australia's Olympic bobsleigh athletes.

items.title: Do you know who owns your GP clinic? The answer might surprise you
items.description: Major insurers like Medibank Private and Bupa are buying up GP clinics in a move that could lead to US-style managed care.

items.title: 'Wholly and solely systemic racism': Anger over closure of Indigenous health hub
items.description: An absence of funding from the ACT and federal governments is forcing the Yerrabi Yurwang Health Hub to close this week, affecting about 400 First Nations patients.
